name: analysis
summary: Reproducible analysis of declared inputs, with separate person review of provenance and method.

rubric.text: The local reproduction check compares the declared program and input against the expected output and records its observed result.
Person review confirms input provenance, selection and limits, with unknowns and missing data stated explicitly.
Person review assesses method suitability, assumptions and interpretation; output equality alone does not establish validity.

checks.note: Manual, advisory example only: bun templates/checks/analysis.mjs <program.mjs> <input.json> <expected-output>. A match proves reproduction, not method validity.
